title: The /kb-backlog filing skill names a kb root's _anchors.csv for an item that rewords or adds a DOC fact
goal: skills/backlog/SKILL.md names the root's _anchors.csv beside expansions.csv in the touches of a research or refresh item that may reword or add a DOC fact, so kb/_self/backlog.md's 'filed by /kb-backlog or scheduled by /kb-sprint plan' holds for the filing half (SP-ce5iig4g review: skills/backlog/SKILL.md:31 names expansions.csv only)
